
	<h1 class="postTitle"><a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/MikeZhang/p/19270341" title="发布于 2025-11-25 22:41">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">FreeSWITCH开启silk编码及转码</span>
    

</a>
</h1>
	<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span>操作系统：Debian 12.5_x64</span></p>
<p><span>FreeSWITCH版本： 1.10.11</span></p>
<p><span>SILK编码由Skype设计，是一种用于VoIP的宽带音频编解码器，它支持8khz、12khz、16khz、24khz四种不同的采样率。今天整理下FreeSWITCH使用silk编码进行通话及转码的笔记，希望对你有帮助。</span></p>
<h1><span><span>一、模块安装及配置</span></span></h1>
<h2><span><span>1、添加模块编译项</span></span></h2>
<p><span>文件：源码根目录的modules.conf文件</span></p>
<p><span>添加（或取消注释）如下代码：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>codecs/mod_silk</pre>
</div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251125222755838-1980692619.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="j8Zp-1764080893430">2、编译及安装</h2>
<div>需要安装依赖：</div>
<div><a href="https://github.com/freeswitch/libsilk" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/freeswitch/libsilk</a></div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251125222844725-72763859.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>如果下载过慢，可从如下渠道获取：</p>
<div>关注微信公众号（聊聊博文，文末可扫码）后回复&nbsp;20251125&nbsp;获取。</div>
<div>libsilk库编译及加载命令如下：</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>./bootstrap.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sh</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
.</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">configure
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">make</span> &amp;&amp; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">make</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">cp</span> /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/silk.pc /usr/lib64/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">pkgconfig
ldd</span></pre>
</div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251125223045254-479940470.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>源码目录执行如下命令：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>autoreconf -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">fiv
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">make</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> clean
.</span>/devel-bootstrap.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sh</span> &amp;&amp; ./configure &amp;&amp; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">make</span> &amp;&amp; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">make</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span></pre>
</div>
<div>会编译mod_silk模块并生成文件：</div>
<div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251125223053940-2107176089.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2><span><span>3、加载mod_silk模块</span></span></h2>
<p><span>编辑 conf/autoload_configs/modules.conf.xml 文件，添加如下内容：</span></p>
</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>&lt;load module=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">mod_silk</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>/&gt;</pre>
</div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251125223130912-1235392348.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;重启FreeSWITCH或执行重新load操作：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>load mod_silk</pre>
</div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251125223201773-1697858851.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>如果加载不报错，则添加mod_silk 模块成功。</p>
<h2><span><span>4、启用编码</span></span></h2>
<p>&nbsp;配置文件路径：</p>
<p><span>/usr/local/freeswitch/conf/vars.xml</span></p>
<p><span>配置文件内容如下（默认）：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">X-PRE-PROCESS </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">cmd</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="set"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> data</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="global_codec_prefs=SILK,OPUS,G722,PCMU,PCMA,L16,H264,VP8"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">X-PRE-PROCESS </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">cmd</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="set"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> data</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="outbound_codec_prefs=SILK,OPUS,G722,PCMU,PCMA,L16,H264,VP8"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span></pre>
</div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251125223259991-857656995.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;重启freeswitch生效。</p>
<h1><span><span>二、使用silk编码通话</span></span></h1>
<h2><span><span>1、配置话机支持silk编码</span></span></h2>
<p><span>配置分机只支持silk编码：</span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251125223331621-14784.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2><span><span>2、验证silk编码通话</span></span></h2>
<p><span>添加测试拨号方案：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">extension </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="playTest"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">condition </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">field</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="destination_number"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> expression</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="^10087$"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">action </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">application</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="answer"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">action </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">application</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="playback"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> data</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="$${hold_music}"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>
      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">condition</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">extension</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span></pre>
</div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251125223405080-41136399.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><span>拨打测试号码（比如10087）进行呼叫测试，效果如下：</span></p>
<div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251125223419454-1752008600.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h1><span><span>三、silk编码转换</span></span></h1>
<h2><span><span>1、开启语音编码转换功能</span></span></h2>
<p>文件：conf/vars.xml</p>
<p>修改或添加内容：</p>
</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">X-PRE-PROCESS </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">cmd</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="set"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> data</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="global_codec_prefs=SILK,OPUS,G722,PCMU,PCMA,L16,H264,VP8"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">X-PRE-PROCESS </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">cmd</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="set"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> data</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="outbound_codec_prefs=SILK,OPUS,G722,PCMU,PCMA,L16,H264,VP8"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">X-PRE-PROCESS </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">cmd</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="set"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">data</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="media_mix_inbound_outbound_codecs=true"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span></pre>
</div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251125223504837-1715566736.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;文件：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>sip_profiles/internal.xml</pre>
</div>
<p><span>修改或添加如下内容：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">    &lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">param </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="inbound-late-negotiation"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> value</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="false"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">param </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="disable-transcoding"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> value</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="false"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span></pre>
</div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251125223600112-668923163.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><span>重启freeswitch生效。</span></p>
<h2><span><span>2、通话效果</span></span></h2>
<p><span>分机1009 PCMU编码</span></p>
<p><span>分机1010 silk编码</span></p>
<p><span>通话效果如下：</span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251125223625305-1184908003.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>

<div>

<p><span>本文相关资源及示例配置，可从如下渠道获取：</span></p>
</div>
<div>关注微信公众号（聊聊博文，文末可扫码）后回复&nbsp;20251125&nbsp;获取。</div>

<p><span>libsilk.tar.gz &nbsp; &nbsp;： &nbsp;libsilk源码</span></p>
